subject: Fraud & Scams
title: Sextortion Scams
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Sextortion Scams.

hook.text: An email claims they have compromising photos of you. Pay in Bitcoin or they'll send them to everyone.

buildup.text: Sextortion scammers use fear and shame to demand payment for photos they usually don't even have.

discovery.text: Mass sextortion emails use passwords from old data breaches to seem credible.

twist.text: Teenagers are increasingly targeted, with devastating emotional consequences.

climax.text: The FBI urges victims never to pay — payment only invites more demands.

punchline.text: They have an old password. They don't have photos.

quiz.question: Do sextortion scammers usually have the photos they claim?
options: No, they usually don't have any compromising material
Only if the victim sent them
